base.note: v1.5.6 was prepared but not applied; v1.5.7 incorporates its approved frontend changes directly over the v1.5.5 baseline.

changes.NAMED_SOURCES_157: Carries forward the approved v1.5.6 named-source parser and safe http/https rendering over the real v1.5.5 baseline.
changes.QUICK_REFERENCE_COLLAPSIBLE_157: Carries forward the full Quick Reference collapsible block, with nested Fuentes y trazabilidad.
changes.OFFICIAL_2026_TWO_PART_157: Adds explicit realistic 2026 mode: 200 questions, Part A 100/120 min, 60-minute intermission, Part B 100/120 min.
changes.PART_ISOLATION_157: Part B is hidden and unreachable until Part A is closed; after the intermission Part A cannot be edited.
changes.INDEPENDENT_CLOCKS_157: Part B starts with a fresh 120-minute clock; unused Part A time does not transfer.
changes.TIMEOUT_TRANSITION_157: Part A timeout transitions to the intermission; Part B timeout submits the exam.
changes.HISTORICAL_INTEGRITY_157: Historical catalog now requires exact 1..100 numbering, or 1..90 for 2020, without duplicates or gaps.
changes.HISTORICAL_AB_157: Historical A+B uses isolated A/intermission/B blocks; 100-question parts use 120 minutes and the 2020 90-question exception is proportionally timed at 108 minutes per part.
changes.OVERVIEW_TIMER_157: Review-before-submit continues consuming the active part clock.
changes.RESPONSIVE_157: Footer actions wrap safely, including a 320–360 px fallback.
changes.SEMANTICS_PRESERVED_157: No changes to scheduler, memory, Supabase, taxonomy, dataset, notes/flags, PT409/recovery or protected session-core/session-storage files.
